thread:
elaine: Quick thread to finalize Q3 pilot launch guardrails for reserved pools + burst UX. Short meeting notes.

sam: TL;DR of customer asks?

elaine: Two pilots: payments (latency-sensitive) and marketplace (cost-aware). Both want clear burst behavior and visible limits.

maria: We should return explicit error codes when burst quota used up, e.g. 429.BURST_EXHAUSTED, with a retry-after header and link.

leah: Console: show current burn-rate, projected exhaustion, and a one-click top-up that opens billing modal. Also show recent preemptions.

jon: Pricing: default buckets small/med/large = 10/60/300 min. Add auto-topup with cap. Overage billed at defined per-minute rate.

deepak: Impl constraints: front-door metering + per-tenant KV segment limits. Short burst cooldown doable at 15s if we cap KV memory per-tenant. Prewarming too many tenants causes OOM risk.

maria: Telemetry: emit metrics: burst_seconds_used, burst_burn_rate, kv_segment_count, last_preempt_ts. Hook regression alerts to eval set.

elaine: Behavior for mid-flight when lease ends? Recommend finish request but tag it as emergency-burst and send alert. Force a hard completion timeout (10s) to protect hosts.

deepak: Agree. Implement hard completion cap + eviction policy on KV cache.

sam: UX: surface recommended SDK retry pattern -- exponential backoff + jitter and show example in docs.

leah: Ops: who triages exhausted burst events? Oncall should page first, then TAM if persistent. Add playbook entry.

elaine: Draft launch checklist:
- Burst meter + leash + 429.BURST_EXHAUSTED implemented.
- Console burn-rate + projected time-to-exhaust + top-up flow.
- Default tiers + billing flows.
- Per-tenant KV limits + 10s completion cap.
- Autoscale burst cooldown=15s behind opt-in flag.
- Telemetry + regression alerting.
- Oncall playbook + support doc.

ops-bot: Reminder: infra change review by Thu 12:00 UTC for Fri deploy window.

jon: Action items: @deepak - leash + KV limits (due Fri), @maria - metrics/alerts (Mon), @jon - pricing + billing UX (Tue), @leah - playbook + docs (Wed), @sam - console mockups (Wed).

elaine: I'll write the launch criteria doc and circulate by Monday for sign-off. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
